examples.arabic: هي بتقول إن الحرب وحشة أوي للأطفال.
examples.english: She says that war is very bad for children.
examples.transliteration: Hiya bitool in el-harb wehsha awi lil-atfal.
examples.storyTitle: War News on the Day of Eid

examples.arabic: الاطفال لعبوا وغنوا كتير وكانوا مبسوطين
examples.english: The children played and sang a lot and were happy.
examples.transliteration: El-atfal la3abu w ghannu kiteer w kanu mabsooteen.
